basics.name: Charlie (Seungjun) Yi
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Biomedical Engineering
basics.summary: First-year Ph.D. student in Biomedical Engineering at the University of Texas at Austin, working in the AI Health Lab. Research focuses on scalable multi-agent LLM systems for clinical NLP and automated thematic analysis.

work.name: AI Health Lab, University of Texas at Austin
work.position: Graduate Research Assistant / Research Project Lead
work.summary: Developed scalable end-to-end, automated multi-agent LLM systems for inductive thematic analysis. Reduced analysis time by over 99%. First to introduce multi-agent LLM framework mirroring human qualitative researchers' workflow.

work.name: KIST Europe
work.summary: Developed end-to-end automatic evaluation pipeline for LLMs on scientific protocol generation. Designed BIOPROT 2.0 benchmark dataset.

education.institution: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)
